name: Schwarz Digits Datacenter Lübbenau
notes: Official Schwarz Digits page says an EUR 11bn data center is being built in Lübbenau on a former power-plant site, planned for completion by end-2027, with around 200 MW connection capacity; local press reports construction timing and planned operation in fiscal 2027.

name: Freyenstein AI data center proposal
developer: Serban DC / Noya Generalplanung und Projektmanagement GmbH
notes: DCD reports proposals for a 700 MW data center outside Freyenstein, estimated at EUR 25bn, with no local planning permission yet and grid-connection questions pending. Freyenstein is part of Wittstock/Dosse in Ostprignitz-Ruppin.

name: Michendorf former Telekom site data center proposal
notes: MAZ reports the plan to build a data center on the former Telekom site in Michendorf was withdrawn / off the table after local debate; earlier MAZ coverage described a Berlin investor seeking to develop the site.

name: Vantage BER1 / Berlin I campus, Ludwigsfelde
notes: Market listings identify the Vantage BER1 / Berlin I campus at Uferring 5, 14974 Ludwigsfelde in Brandenburg Park, with four buildings at full buildout and 56 MW critical IT load; Vantage lists the Berlin I Germany campus at the same Ludwigsfelde address.

name: Trebbin data center proposal
developer: Unnamed developer / SDC Capital Partners referenced in market listings
notes: DCD reports Trebbin council could not approve the scheme due to questions including building height; MAZ described an investor planning a data center on a commercial plot in Trebbin. Baxtel market context references SDC Capital Partners planning a data center on a 23-acre Trebbin site.

name: NEOIX Wünsdorf AI data center
notes: NEOIX says its 30 MW data center development in Wünsdorf, Brandenburg received preliminary approval and will test advanced cooling and renewable integration. Wünsdorf is in Zossen, Teltow-Fläming.

name: Landkreis Uckermark modular data center procurement, Prenzlau
notes: Public-tender aggregator summarizing procurement documents says Landkreis Uckermark is buying a prefabricated modular data center, 40 kW / 6 racks, to be delivered and commissioned at Prenzlau by 2027.

name: b.r.m. IT & Aerospace green data center, Bremen Airport
notes: Operator site describes its Bremen location and long-standing green IT / sustainable data center work; company address shown as Hanna-Kunath-Strasse 31, Bremen.

name: SIEVERS Bremen data center
notes: DCD reports SIEVERS opened a Tier 4-certified 2,000 sqm facility in a former nuclear shelter in Bremen, operational June 26, 2025; DataCenterMap lists SIEVERS Bremen at Zwinglistrasse 31.

name: LWLcom Bremen data centers
notes: DataCenterMap and Cloudscene list LWLcom Bremen colocation facilities, including BRE01 at Pastorenweg 70 and additional Bremen city data centers; BRE01 specs show 900 sqm whitespace and 1,200 sqm total building size.

name: ColocationIX DC1
notes: Inflect lists ColocationIX DC1 as a colocation data center at Wachtstrasse 17-24 in Bremen, operated by ColocationIX GmbH; DataCenterPlatform lists multiple ColocationIX Bremen facilities.
